snoozed_until.description:

sooner); null wakes it.

Email "unread" sends what stays unread for EmailDelay; "off" sends
nothing but the digest.

archive_done_rollover_rest; null or absent sends them to the backlog.

(one project only).

or a comment.

words between U+0002 and U+0003.

memberships just in time with this role; null: only existing members.

Forgejo instance).

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is when the forge last told of it.

display.description:

board WIP limits…, as the client stores them.

their owner only.
